CookiesHelpText: Manage session cookies for Radar YTM via automatic extraction, the manual assistant or file import.
CookiesBtnOpenFolderHint: Open the cookies folder in Windows Explorer
CookiesExtractTitle: Extract cookies directly from your browser
CookiesExtractDesc: Sign in to YouTube or YouTube Music beforehand in the selected browser. Cazador YTM will securely extract the active session cookies.
CookiesBrowserLabel: Browser where your session is open:
CookiesSaveJson: Also save in JSON format (.json) in addition to .txt
CookiesBtnExtractHint: Start automatic cookie extraction from the browser
CookiesAssistantTitle: Get cookies using a browser extension
CookiesAssistantDesc: A 100% reliable and compatible method if your browser blocks direct reading due to Windows DPAPI restrictions.
CookiesStep1: 1. Install the recommended 'Get cookies.txt LOCALLY' extension in your browser (available for Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Brave).
CookiesStep2: 2. Open the URL 'youtube.com/robots.txt' in your browser to activate the YouTube domain without loading heavy videos.
CookiesStep3: 3. Click the extension icon and copy the cookies text.
CookiesStep4: 4. Click the 'Paste from Clipboard' button below and then 'Validate and Save Cookies'.
CookiesExtDesc: You can install it from your browser's store. It is optional, open source, and never sends your cookies to any server.
CookiesBtnExtChromeHint: Open the extension page in the Chrome Web Store
CookiesBtnExtFirefoxHint: Open the extension page on Firefox Add-ons
CookiesBtnRobotsHint: Open the youtube.com robots.txt link in the browser
CookiesManualPlaceholder: Paste the cookies content here in Netscape or JSON format...

CookiesFileDesc: Export a backup copy of your cookies or import an existing cookie file from your computer.
CookiesExportDesc: Save the active cookie file to any folder on your computer (.txt or .json format) to back it up or use it on another device.
CookiesImportDesc: Select a previously downloaded cookies.txt or cookies.json file to load into Cazador YTM.
